name: Deformable Neural Radiance Fields (Nerfies)
definition: A method for reconstructing non-rigidly deforming scenes by mapping observation-space points to a canonical template space using a learned deformation field conditioned on a per-frame latent code.
summary: Deformable Neural Radiance Fields reconstructs non-rigidly deforming scenes by mapping observation-space coordinates to a static canonical template via a continuous deformation field conditioned on per-frame latent codes.
